facts.fact: Kayla 第二次在 Ares 房间醒来，这次是清醒到达；他处理完伤口后说会送她回家
facts.anchor: This is the second time I have woken up in here, but at least this time I was conscious when I arrived

facts.fact: 睡颜的 Ares 卸下表演，Kayla 发现他下颌一道来历不明的淡疤
facts.anchor: that’s when I notice a faint scar along his jaw

facts.fact: 事后 Ares 把亲密关系归因为距离与统计概率，Kayla 复述时充满无语
facts.anchor: a physical response was statistically likely

facts.fact: Kayla 指出：他的解释让原本不复杂的事变得奇怪
facts.anchor: it’s not complicated, but it’s now weird

facts.fact: 走廊里 Clay 一眼扫到 Ares 的衬衫在她身上，语气带刺却先警告他别开口
facts.anchor: Ares’s shirt looks better on you than it does on him

facts.fact: 早餐店里 Kayla 瞥见 Clay 手机存着 Kyle 的地址、日程与 Nixie 的备注
facts.anchor: I glimpse Kyle’s address, schedule, and Nixie’s name in the notes

facts.fact: Clay 用 Kayla 手机里的完整记录当面对质 Kyle，逼他选一个版本
facts.anchor: Jess scrolled through all of it

facts.fact: Clay 一拳放倒 Kyle 并划下两条禁令；回程车上 Kayla 意识到他第一次说出不带恶意的话
facts.anchor: these are the most words Clay has ever said to me that weren’t intended to make me feel unwelcome
